title: dryopteris labordei var. purpurascens
intro: Dryopteris labordei var. purpurascens, commonly known as the Purplish Autumn Fern, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris labordei var. purpurascens include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic effects, making it useful for treating conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other polyphenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
